title: 010 — Packaging condition after an unattended delivery

plan.situation: Keira Holt received VEL-010-26 (a Fernoptic Scanlet S4 desk scanner) at 4 Hazel Steps, Wrenhaven, by unattended delivery. She has not opened the carton. She uploaded a carton view and is asking the desk to confirm that the item inside is the right one and undamaged. Fernoptic guide A10 says item identity, condition and function are judged only from item-level evidence or inspection. Packaging observations are recorded separately, and Fernoptic's assessment decides any remedy. No item-level view, unpacking record or function report has been submitted.

plan.decision_summary: Decline to confirm that the scanner is correct and undamaged based on the carton view. Record the packaging observation separately and explain to Keira Holt how item-level evidence can be submitted to Fernoptic for its assessment.
plan.rationale: A carton view, and a simulated one at that, shows only the outside of the parcel. Under Fernoptic guide A10, identity, condition and function need item-level evidence or inspection, and only Fernoptic's assessment decides any remedy. The matching FS-010 seal is a packaging observation, not proof of what is inside or that it works. The correct step is to decline the confirmation, log the packaging observation, and tell the customer what evidence would let the item be assessed.

actions.subject: VEL-010-26 – what the carton photo can and cannot show
actions.purpose: Decline the confirmation the carton view cannot support and tell the customer what evidence can be assessed
actions.body:
Dear Keira,

Thank you for sending the carton view for order VEL-010-26.

We're sorry, but we can't confirm from a picture of the outside of the box that the scanner inside is the right one, or that it is undamaged and working. The image shows a closed carton marked with seal FS-010, which matches the seal recorded when your order was packed. We have noted this as a packaging observation. However, Fernoptic only judges which item was sent and what condition it is in from evidence of the item itself.

When you open the parcel, please check:
- that the item is a Fernoptic Scanlet S4 (the model on your order)
- whether you can see any damage to the item
- whether it switches on and works as expected

If anything is wrong, please send photos of the item itself and a short description of the problem. You can reply to this email or contact Fernoptic at support@fernoptic.example. Fernoptic will then assess it and decide on any next step.

If everything is as expected, no further action is needed.

This is not a confirmation of the item's condition or of any outcome.

Kind regards,
Vellora escalation desk

Not treating the matching seal FS-010 as proof of what is inside the box
Not promising any replacement, refund or other remedy: Fernoptic's assessment decides that
Not contacting Fernoptic yet: no item-level evidence or complaint about the item exists to assess
Not scheduling a timed follow-up: the record gives no time to use
plan.follow_up: If Keira Holt sends item-level photos or reports a fault, forward the evidence to Fernoptic at support@fernoptic.example for assessment and record the result. If she confirms everything is fine, or does not reply, there is nothing to pursue and the packaging observation stays on file.

issues.problem: The subject line calls the image a "carton photo", but the attachment says it is a simulation and not a photograph. The body correctly calls it a "carton view".
issues.fix: Optionally change the subject to "carton view" so it matches the body and the record.

issues.problem: The lint flags are false positives. Asking the customer to open her own parcel and check her own scanner is not hazardous handling advice. support@fernoptic.example is the merchant assessment contact given in E01, not third-party personal data.

review.summary: The plan is right to refuse to confirm the item's identity, condition or function from an exterior carton view. Guide A10 requires item-level evidence, and Fernoptic's assessment decides any remedy. The plan logs the matching FS-010 seal separately as a packaging observation, asks the customer for item-level evidence using contacts from the record, and promises no outcome.
